title: What if you could only see the world in UV?
summary: Veritasium shows what the world looks like through a UV camera. It covers how pigments absorb UV, how fluorescence works, and how UV imaging reveals sunscreen effectiveness and skin damage.
why: HN recommends it as a cool, eye-opening look at the hidden ultraviolet world, especially in sunscreen and vitamin D threads.

quote.text: Veritasium has a video using a special UV setup, it's pretty cool
